description: Declaration of the polar_decoder_impl class implementing a polar code decoder based on TS38.212 specifications, including internal structures, node processing methods, and initialization routines.

classes.name: polar_decoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a polar code decoder using SSC algorithm, supporting node type management, state tracking, and decoding routines.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes internal decoder parameters, including LLRs, node types, and state, based on input code parameters and frozen set.

methods.name: rate_0_node
methods.description: Processes a RATE_0 node, setting all bits below it to zero and updating active node pointers.

methods.name: rate_1_node
methods.description: Processes a RATE_1 node, making hard decisions on estimated bits and updating message bits.

methods.name: rate_r_node
methods.description: Processes a RATE_R node by combining child node outputs and performing XOR operations.

methods.name: simplified_node
methods.description: Handles node processing based on node type, managing LLRs and estimated bits.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Performs decoding of input LLRs into data bits using the SSC algorithm.
